title: Update navigation: move Logout into Settings, add Profile in header, and add Reels after Video

requirements.text: In the top header (frontend/src/components/Header.tsx), replace the authenticated-state primary button text/action from "Logout" to "Profile" so that when the user is authenticated it navigates to "/profile" instead of logging out. When the user is not authenticated, the button must remain "Login" and must continue to trigger the Internet Identity login flow.

quotes: In settings button we have logout option so keep logout option in settings and replace logout with profile at top add reel button after videos

acceptanceCriteria: When logged out, the header button label is "Login" and it triggers login.
When logged in, the header button label is "Profile" and it navigates to /profile.
Clicking the header button while logged in does not log the user out.

requirements.text: Keep the Logout action available under the Settings (gear) menu in the header (frontend/src/components/Header.tsx) and ensure it still logs the user out (clears identity and clears React Query cache) when clicked.

quotes: In settings button we have logout option so keep logout option in settings

acceptanceCriteria: When logged in, the Settings dropdown contains a menu item labeled "Logout".
Clicking "Logout" in Settings logs the user out and clears client-side cached data as it did previously.
There is no other Logout control shown in the header outside of Settings.

requirements.text: Add a new primary navigation item labeled "Reel" positioned immediately after "Video" in the bottom navigation (frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx). Create a new route at "/reel" in the router (frontend/src/App.tsx) and implement a placeholder Reel page (new file under frontend/src/pages) with English user-facing text indicating the Reel feed is coming soon, similar in structure to the existing Video placeholder page.
acceptanceCriteria: Bottom navigation shows items in an order where "Reel" appears directly after "Video".
/reel renders a placeholder page with English text indicating the feature is coming soon.
The Reel nav item shows an active state when the current path is /reel.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Backend must remain single-actor; no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Implementing an actual reels/video feed experience (uploading, playback, infinite scrolling, recommendations).
Changing authentication providers or adding third-party auth beyond Internet Identity.
Any new backend data models or persistence for reels.
